title: The base-1/2 geometric partial sums form a Cauchy sequence
statement: Cauchy (sumRange (fun n => pow half n)) -- the geometric series' convergence, Spivak Ch.22-23's standard geometric-decay estimate at the concrete ratio 1/2. Eliminates the Nat.le_total disjunction (never branching on the undecidable CReal.le itself) and calls the ordered-pair bound geomCauchyOrderedHalf at whichever of (m,n)/(n,m) satisfies its own a<=b side condition, with the single fixed witness K := 7. This is CLAUDE.md's named CReal.geomCauchy, and it is distinct from the not-yet-registered general-base CReal.geomCauchyOfLt (on an unmerged sibling branch, out of scope for this batch).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.geomCauchy : CReal.Cauchy (CReal.sumRange (fun (x0 : AxNat) => CReal.pow (CReal.ofRat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))) x0))
